source_changes: Hosted package installation, Chromium installation, and actual acceptance use three sequential fresh resource leases on the same runner with unique journal IDs.
Pinned playwright-core 1.56.1 package install disables npm audit and funding requests; retains ignore-scripts.

Browser phase installs full Chromium with --no-shell. Package version must equal 1.56.1; acceptance verifies the pinned package executable exists and the expected Chromium revision has Playwright INSTALLATION_COMPLETE marker.
Acceptance does no runtime installation. Published Store CRX hash and adapted identity checks remain unchanged.
A bounded read-only top probe exposes exit code, signal, killed status, bounded stderr, and CPU lines before the guard; failure stops workflow.
Resource journals upload on failure as well as success. All guard thresholds and ownership enforcement unchanged.
CI only cancels in-progress pull-request verification; main and tag verification finish while later same-ref runs queue.
phase_result_semantics: Workflow phases require previous steps to succeed. Any refused or invalid setup lease stops later phases; its result remains refused/invalid. No invalid setup receipt is promoted to acceptance. A completed package can persist on the same host between healthy phases, with no threshold relaxation.
remaining: Fresh independent source peer then guarded hosted workflow dispatch. No browser, build, or installation was run locally or remotely by this tranche.
